title: IELTS Academic 19 - Listening Test 3 - Part 1
transcriptHtml:
LISTENING TRANSCRIPT - PART 1

💡 Audio-Track Sync: Bấm vào bất kỳ câu nào dưới đây để phát audio ngay đúng câu đó!

00:43ANNOUNCER: Part 1. You will hear two neighbours who live in an apartment block talking about shopping for food.
00:51ANNOUNCER: First, you have some time to look at questions 1 to 6.
01:25ANNOUNCER: Now listen carefully and answer questions 1 to 6.
01:33LEON: Hi, Shannon. How are you settling into your new flat?
01:37SHANNON: Really well, thanks.
01:38LEON: You look like you're going shopping.
01:40SHANNON: Yes, I am. My cousins are coming to stay for a couple of days and I have to cook for them.
01:47LEON: Well, there are plenty of places to buy food in Kite Place. It's the area by the harbour.
01:54SHANNON: Oh, okay. I'll find that on the map. Thanks. What sort of food do you need to get?
02:01SHANNON: Well, neither of them eats meat, but they both like fish.
02:05LEON: Well, there's a really good fish market there.
02:08SHANNON: Oh, great. Where is it exactly?
02:11LEON: It's at the far end of Kite Place. So you have to go over the bridge, and then it's on the right.
02:20SHANNON: Okay. Is it open all day?
02:23LEON: It doesn't close until four, but I'd recommend going earlier than that. It does run out of some things.
02:30SHANNON: Oh, I don't want that to happen.
02:32LEON: As long as you get there by 3.30, you should be fine. It's only eleven now, so plenty of time.
02:39SHANNON: Right. Do you need to buy vegetables too?
02:43SHANNON: I do, and I want to avoid all the plastic packaging in the supermarket.
02:48LEON: Well, there's a really nice organic shop there. Now, what's it called? It's the name of a flower. I know, it's Rose.
02:58SHANNON: Oh, that's a nice name.
03:00LEON: Yeah. It sells vegetables and quite a lot of other stuff.
03:04SHANNON: And where's that?
03:05LEON: Well, as you reach the market, you'll see a big grey building on your left. I think it used to be a warehouse. Anyway, now it's a restaurant upstairs, but the ground floor has two shops either side of the entrance, and it's the one on the left.
03:23SHANNON: That's easy enough.
03:24LEON: You can't miss it. There's also a big sign on the pavement, so you can look for that.
03:31SHANNON: Fine. I guess if I need anything else, I'll have to go to the supermarket.
03:37LEON: Yeah, you should be able to get everything you need. But there's a minibus that goes to the supermarket if you need it. It's purple and the number is 289.
03:49SHANNON: Thanks. That's great.
03:55ANNOUNCER: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions 7 to 10.
04:21ANNOUNCER: Now listen and answer questions 7 to 10.
04:28LEON: So what do you need to get at the fish market? The salmon is always very good and the shellfish.
04:35SHANNON: I'm going to make a curry I think and I need about 12 prawns for that.
04:41LEON: They'll have plenty of those. OK. Have you ever tried samphire? SHANNON: No, what's that? LEON: It's a type of seaweed. I just ask for a handful and you fry it in butter. It's delicious. SHANNON: Oh, I might try that. How do you spell it? LEON: It's S-A-M-P-H-I-R-E.
05:09SHANNON: Great. It's always good to try something different. Yeah. I'll see what beans they have in the organic shop, and I think I'll get something for dessert there.
05:21LEON: How about a mango?
05:23SHANNON: I'm not sure. They're not always ripe. I'd prefer a melon. It's bigger too.
05:30LEON: Good idea. The owner also sells a lot of spices there that you can put in a curry and things like coconut.
05:39SHANNON: Oh, that's very helpful. I'll have a look.
05:43LEON: No problem. I know bread doesn't really go with curry, but I always like to have some in case. As I said, all the bread is homemade, and there's lots of variety. I like the brown bread myself.
05:58SHANNON: Mmm, sounds good.
05:59LEON: They sell other things there too. Like cakes? I love chocolate cake. Well, not that. But they have a whole range of tarts, and the best are the strawberry ones.
06:14SHANNON: Perfect. Hopefully I won't even have to go to the supermarket.
06:22ANNOUNCER: That is the end of part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.

steps: • Đáp án đúng: harbour (hoặc harbor)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'Well, there are plenty of places to buy food in Kite Place. It's the area by the harbour.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'near the harbour' = the area by the harbour.
• Đáp án đúng: bridge
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'So you have to go over the bridge, and then it's on the right.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'cross the bridge' = go over the bridge.
• Đáp án đúng: 3.30 (hoặc three thirty / 3:30 / half past three)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'As long as you get there by three thirty, you should be fine.'
• Phân tích bẫy: Người nói nhắc 'doesn't close until four' (4 giờ đóng cửa) nhưng khuyên nên đến trước 3.30.
• Đáp án đúng: Rose (hoặc rose)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'It's the name of a flower. I know, it's Rose.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'called Rose'.
• Đáp án đúng: sign
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'There's also a big sign on the pavement, so you can look for that.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'look for the large sign' = big sign on the pavement.
• Đáp án đúng: purple
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'It's purple and the number is 289.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'take a purple minibus'.
• Đáp án đúng: samphire
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'Have you ever tried samphire? ... It's a type of seaweed. I just ask for a handful... It's S-A-M-P-H-I-R-E.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'a handful of samphire (type of seaweed)'.
• Đáp án đúng: melon
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'How about a mango? SHANNON: I'm not sure. They're not always ripe. I'd prefer a melon. It's bigger too.'
• Phân tích bẫy: Mango bị từ chối vì chưa chắc đã chín, Shannon chọn melon cho món tráng miệng.
• Đáp án đúng: coconut
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'sells a lot of spices there that you can put in a curry and things like coconut.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'spices and coconut'.
• Đáp án đúng: strawberry
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'they have a whole range of tarts, and the best are the strawberry ones.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'a strawberry tart'.
